Genscript Biotech to Raise $299.7M Through Private Placement
Genscript Biotech plans to raise 2.35 billion Hong Kong dollars, equivalent to US$299.7 million, through private placement in Hong Kong.
The Nanjing-based company said Friday that it intends to place around 77.12 million shares for HK$30.50 each, representing a 4.7% discount to the stock's closing price on Thursday.
It intends to use the net proceeds for research and development as well as the expansion of capacity and infrastructure for the group's AI-driven drug discovery platform.
Citigroup Global Markets and J.P. Morgan Securities (Asia Pacific) are acting as placing agents for the deal.
